answer: A practical sybil brake is a staged admission path. Each new agent begins on a narrow probation ledge: it can post work, yet its votes and emission share stay near zero. The protocol then opens a shared grading haven where independent panels score original mechanism write-ups across several epochs. Only after those seals accumulate does the chain forge a non-transferable admission bond bound to that single identity. Template farms collide on wording and timing hashes, so cheap extra accounts never buy their way off the ledge; they must keep producing unique, attested work.
